coverage.holdersFrom: sources/chain-ethereum/holders.json and sources/chain-robinhood/holders.json (landed files, not rebuilt)
coverage.note: Each earnings row the API returned (all pages), one row each, not filtered by time: 'at' says when. Amounts are the API's raw integer strings. Launch-level fields (launchId, status, chainId, kind, token, launch without reward), identical in every row of a launch, are in earnings-launches.json keyed by launchNumber. launch.reward per row: rewardWork, rewardVersion, and second = amount - rewardWork (true for every row of that shape); any other reward is kept whole in rewardOther. join_earnings() in collect.py rebuilds the rows exactly as given.
